questions.question_text: Why is organizing a post-event cleanup important after a school event like a dance?

options.text: It’s only necessary if the venue charges a cleaning fee
It shows responsibility and ensures you can use the space again for future events
It’s a way to avoid returning borrowed items
It guarantees the next event will be bigger

correct_answer.text: It shows responsibility and ensures you can use the space again for future events

questions.question_text: What is a key step in financial reconciliation after a school fundraiser?

options.text: Ignoring expenses to focus only on money earned
Calculating profit or loss by subtracting total expenses from total income
Guessing the final numbers without checking receipts
Spending any profit immediately without reporting to anyone

correct_answer.text: Calculating profit or loss by subtracting total expenses from total income

questions.question_text: How can you effectively gather feedback after a school talent show?

options.text: Avoid asking attendees anything to keep things simple
Use quick surveys or casual chats to learn what people liked and what could be improved
Only ask your best friends for their opinions
Wait until the next event to see if anyone complains

correct_answer.text: Use quick surveys or casual chats to learn what people liked and what could be improved

questions.question_text: What is a good way to celebrate success and learn from mistakes after a school movie night?

options.text: Focus only on what went wrong and skip any celebration
Host a small team hangout to thank everyone and reflect on wins and areas to improve
Ignore the team’s efforts and start planning the next event right away
Only celebrate if the event made a huge profit

correct_answer.text: Host a small team hangout to thank everyone and reflect on wins and areas to improve
